$comment: The fictional demonstrations this repository may release on the demonstration channel (G6-2, APR-JE-039; G6-2-DESIGN.md section 9). A configuration with demo and noindex switched on is NOT a demonstration unless its configuration digest (the 'configuration' part of the candidate digest) is registered here; client-style content labelled as a demonstration is therefore refused (RG-13). Changing the demonstration's configuration changes the digest: register the new one deliberately, with its governance record. Registration is a statement of fact about a configuration the owner has called the fictional Jade & Ember demonstration; it approves nothing for release.
